description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the CountryDao data access object within the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods to verify fetching of country and province data, using fixture data for assertions.

classes.name: CountryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various methods of the CountryDao class, including fetching country and province lists by different criteria.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up the DAO instance, and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Tests the getCountryList method to ensure it retrieves the correct list of countries matching the fixture data.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Tests the getProvinceList method for correct retrieval of provinces for a specified country code.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a country entity by its name, checking both existing and non-existing cases.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a country entity by its code, including non-existing code handling.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a province by its code, including handling of non-existent code.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Tests fetching of province data based on its name, including non-existent name case.
